text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Bubble Gum Fellow! That makes four 
consecutive wins! 
We can hardly wait for this young prodigy 
GⅠ Umamusume's ‘Satsuki Sho’!!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Back in the Junior Class, I was simply 
overflowing with hope. 
My dreams just kept swelling bigger and 
bigger, with no end in sight...”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I never even imagined the moment they 
would burst and scatter.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“A six-month recovery time... you can't be 
serious! 
Then what about the ‘Satsuki Sho’!? It's 
next week!”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“Unfortunately... 
We have no choice but to give up on the 
‘Japanese Derby’ as well.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“No way...! 
Then, my Classic season is............”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Is it all over just like that...?

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“『—The Spring Tenno Sho is about to 
begin. 
—They're primed and ready... and they're 
off!』”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“(The 1st favorite, Narita Brian. The 
‘Monster’... the Triple Crown Umamusume... 
Girls who make history really are 
incredible right from the Classic 
season.)”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Haaah............ 
Ah, this won't do... sighing like that...”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“『Here comes Sakura Laurel charging in! 
It's Sakura! Sakura! 
Sakura Laurel takes the lead...!』”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“『Sakura Laurel crosses the finish line 
now!! 
Once again, the cherry blossoms are in 
full bloom at Kyoto Racecourse! Sakura is 
in full bloom!』”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Sakura... Laurel...? 
Wait, isn't that... that girl who was 
always taking breaks from injuries?”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“『—See...? I was able to bloom...! But 
not just yet. 
...My dream, the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe... is still so much further 
ahead!』”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Is that... what you were thinking...? All 
this time...?)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(How many times did she have to overcome 
pain like this...? 
Compared to me, it must have been... so 
much harder for her...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel......

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Sakura Laurel...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Laurel... me too...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (I'm going to stand back up too—!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-chan, let's have a great race 
today!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's! But I'm taking the win today. 
I'm making a declaration... I will 
"overcome" just like you—!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So those were the feelings you brought 
into the race...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I felt like if I could beat her, 
I'd finally be able to say I've 
"completely overcome it."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—And then you went and actually won! 
Ah, I was so frustrated back then. I was 
on a winning streak, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you were listening? That's kind of 
embarrassing. 
...Beating you back then is something I 
take real pride in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It means a lot to me too... 
I never imagined that my running was 
giving someone else strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Especially to a "prodigy" like you—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Is Sakura Laurel struggling?! 
Bubble Gum Fellow! It's Bubble Gum Fellow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little more! Just a little bit 
more...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Uwaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
GOAAAL! It's Bubble Gum Fellow!! 
Only the second in history! A 
Classic-class Umamusume has claimed the 
Autumn Shield!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't break through.........! 
Ahh.........! 
She's so strong... Truly...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Unbelievable. I know all too well how 
hard it is coming off an injury... 
And yet...! So this is what a "genius" is 
capable of...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Second place goes to Mayano Top Gun! Third 
place is Sakura Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Laurel!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I won too... Sakura Laurel...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I mean... it's just that I got inspired on 
my own, really. 
Because you overcame your injury... and 
kept moving forward...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I see... Is that so...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
("Talent" can be cruel. There's nothing 
you can do about it. 
Even so, a late-blooming cherry blossom 
will bloom—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And on that day, I stood on the very same 
stage as a prodigy like that—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—A cherry blossom that endured the 
winter... 
Truly great Umamusume possess an 
indomitable spirit as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu! 
Ikuno-chan! Did you see that? It went up 
super high!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... you have my respect. 
It seems my worries were unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You certainly are quite vigorous!
